Home is currently under a COMPLETE REMODEL- new pics coming soon! Updates to kitchen, bedrooms, baths, flooring and furniture throughout home!

HOME HIGHLIGHTS:
- Sandy private beach is your backyard!
- Private heated plunge pool on second level
- TVs in all bedrooms
- Two adult beach cruisers
- Gas grill
- Private driveway with parking for 4 cars
- Fully stocked kitchen complete with standard drip coffee maker, Keurig, and Nespresso machine
- Sandpiper Linen Program Participant: All linen, bedding and bath, are the highest quality.

OPTIONAL ADD-ONS:
-The pool can be heated for $50/day November - April
--Vacation Cancellation Protection- Allows cancellation for any reason up to 48 hours in advance of stay and guarantees 50% of all monies refunded ($125 fee applies at booking)

HOME DETAILS:
First level: Parking is under the home with 4+ private spots. Walk up the stairs to enter the home.

Second Floor: When entering you will find the w/d and an exit out to the large first floor deck and pool. At the end of the hall is an in-wall bunk bed (sleeps 2), a large private bedroom with 2 full beds with gulf side views and private ensuite bath (shower/tub combo). Next to this room is a private queen room. There is a shared bathroom for the queen room and the wall bunks. On the deck you will find the pool with waterfall feature, Lounge chairs, propane grill and a patio reaching each end of the house to provide the ultimate views and relaxation!

Top Floor: As you walk up the stairs, you are enveloped in nothing but gorgeous white sand and blue water with floor to ceiling windows. First you will walk into the large family room with oversized HGTV, spacious couch along with additional seating. On this open-concept level, you also have your dining table with room for 8. The kitchen is a generous size, with all the utensils a Chef would need and 3 bar stools allow socializing as you cook. Half bath is off the kitchen. The master is also on this level with gorgeous ocean views, a king bed and private master bath.

ACCOMMODATIONS (Sleeps 10): UPDATED SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS COMING for 2026!!
Bedroom 1: Two full beds with TV / private bath (shower only)(Sleeps 4)
Bedroom 2: Queen with TV/ shared bath (shower/tub combo)
Bunk room in hallway with sliding door for privacy (Sleeps 2)
Bedroom 3: King with TV / private master bath (separate bath& shower with dual sinks)

Heaven on Earth! La Casa Esmeralda is your private, luxurious beach front home where every room has beautiful views of the Gulf! This home is exquisitely designed and detailed with fine finishes and the most amazing views. Unique to this home is the East - West beach orientation so every bedroom and family area has a spectacular view of the ocean. The east and west views are also unobstructed so you will get the most amazing sunrise and sunset views on the panhandle. We are only minutes away from the Rosemary Beach community and Alys Beach developments; so you can enjoy the energy of these without the crowds on the beach. Everyone will love the splash pool with it's waterfall and amazing views of the gulf. There is also a propane gas grill for guests to use.

* Includes beach towels and 4 beach chairs. Beach chair setup service available for an additional cost.
* There is an additional fee of $50 / day to heat the pool.
FREE WIFI
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.

description: Located on the beach, this vacation home is in Inlet Beach, a neighborhood in Panama City Beach. The area's natural beauty can be seen at Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach, while Frank Brown Park and Shipwreck Island Waterpark are popular area attractions. Emerald Coast Mirror Maze and SkyWheel are also worth visiting. Snorkeling, surfing/body boarding, and fishing offer great chances to get out on the surrounding water, or you can seek out an adventure with cycling nearby.
